comment: masks signs every id token with RS256 and advertises only that in id_token_signing_alg_values_supported. A client cannot register alg 'none', so the module has nothing to drive.
masks defines four scopes and 'address' is not one. scopes_supported says so, and an actor has no address to release.
As above for 'phone'. The thirteen profile claims cover what masks holds about an actor; a phone number is not among them.
Asks for every standard scope at once, address and phone included, so it skips for the same reason those two do.
request_uri_parameter_supported is declared false. masks refuses a request_uri with request_uri_not_supported rather than reading past it, which is the outcome this module's name allows for.
request_parameter_supported is declared false, for the same reason: silently preferring unsigned query parameters over a signed request object is the wrong direction to fail in.
